sources.title: ZipNN: Lossless Compression for AI Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: While there is a vast model compression literature deleting parts of the model weights for faster inference, we investigate a more traditional type of compression - one that represents the model in a compact form and is coupled with a decompression algorithm that returns it to its original form and size - namely lossless compression.

sources.title: IBM's ZipNN Can Shrink AI Models by 33% with Zero ... - TipRanks
sources.snippet: The idea for ZipNN came when IBM researchers, working with universities like MIT and Tel Aviv University, discovered that part of a model's data—called exponents—follows a predictable pattern. These exponents are part of floating-point numbers used to store information in AI models.
